claims.statement: Göteborg's revenue last week (w42, 12–18 Oct 2026) was 1,059,350.70 SEK.
Göteborg's revenue the week before (w41, 5–11 Oct 2026) was 884,866.90 SEK.
Revenue increased by 174,483.80 SEK week-over-week, a rise of approximately +19.7%.

evidence.sql:
WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_ts >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z' AND o.order_ts < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z' THEN 'last_week (w42: 12–18 Oct)'
      WHEN o.order_ts >= '2026-10-05T00:00:00Z' AND o.order_ts < '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z' THEN 'week_before (w41: 5–11 Oct)'
    END AS week_label,
    ROUND(SUM(l.qty * l.unit_price - l.discount), 2) AS revenue
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE s.city = 'Göteborg'
    AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_ts >= '2026-10-05T00:00:00Z'
    AND o.order_ts < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT week_label, revenue
FROM weekly
ORDER BY week_label

claims.statement: Shorts Trail (Kust, Bottoms) had the highest return rate last week at 15.09% (8 returned out of 53 non-cancelled orders).
Sleeping Bag -5 (Björk & Co, Equipment) ranked 2nd with a return rate of 11.54% (6 of 52 orders).
Headlamp (Polaris Gear, Accessories) ranked 3rd with a return rate of 10.61% (7 of 66 orders).
Softshell (Björk & Co, Outerwear) ranked 4th with a return rate of 9.72% (7 of 72 orders).
Dry Bag 10L (Polaris Gear, Equipment) ranked 5th with a return rate of 8.93% (5 of 56 orders).

evidence.sql:
WITH product_return_rate AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.brand,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN o.order_id END) * 1.0
            / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id END) AS return_rate,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN o.order_id END) AS returned_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id END) AS total_non_cancelled_orders
    FROM order_lines l
    JOIN orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p ON l.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.order_ts >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'
      AND o.order_ts <  '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, p.category, p.brand
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id END) > 0
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    name,
    category,
    brand,
    returned_orders,
    total_non_cancelled_orders,
    ROUND(return_rate * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM product_return_rate
ORDER BY return_rate DESC
LIMIT 5

evidence.sql:
WITH last_week_lines AS (
    SELECT
        l.product_id,
        o.order_id,
        o.status
    FROM lakehouse_demo.order_lines l
    JOIN lakehouse_demo.orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_ts >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'
      AND o.order_ts <  '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
),
product_return_rate AS (
    SELECT
        lwl.product_id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.brand,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lwl.status = 'returned' THEN lwl.order_id END) * 1.0
            / COUNT(DISTINCT lwl.order_id) AS return_rate,
        COUNT(DISTINCT lwl.order_id) AS total_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lwl.status = 'returned' THEN lwl.order_id END) AS returned_orders
    FROM last_week_lines lwl
    JOIN lakehouse_demo.products p ON lwl.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY lwl.product_id, p.name, p.category, p.brand
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    name,
    category,
    brand,
    returned_orders,
    total_orders,
    return_rate
FROM product_return_rate
ORDER BY return_rate DESC, total_orders DESC
LIMIT 5

claims.statement: Göteborg had the highest revenue last week at 1059350.7 SEK
Uppsala was second with revenue of 931145.5 SEK
Umeå was third with revenue of 904174.2 SEK
Stockholm had revenue of 868542.5 SEK
Västerås had revenue of 829753.5 SEK
Malmö had revenue of 822856.0 SEK
Linköping had revenue of 809634.6 SEK
Örebro had the lowest revenue last week at 741133.7 SEK

evidence.sql:
SELECT
    s.store_id,
    s.name AS store_name,
    s.city,
    s.region,
    ROUND(SUM(l.qty * l.unit_price - l.discount), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_lines l
JOIN orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND o.order_ts >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'
  AND o.order_ts <  '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.name, s.city, s.region
ORDER BY revenue DESC

claims.statement: Göteborg's revenue last week (week 42) was 1059350.7 SEK
Göteborg's revenue the week before (week 41) was 884866.9 SEK
Revenue increased by 174483.8 SEK week-on-week, from 884866.9 to 1059350.7

evidence.sql:
WITH goeteborg_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.status,
        o.order_ts,
        CASE
            WHEN o.order_ts >= '2026-10-05T00:00:00Z' AND o.order_ts < '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z' THEN 'week_before'
            WHEN o.order_ts >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z' AND o.order_ts < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z' THEN 'last_week'
        END AS period
    FROM orders o
    JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.city = 'Göteborg'
      AND o.order_ts >= '2026-10-05T00:00:00Z'
      AND o.order_ts < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'
)
SELECT
    period,
    ROUND(SUM(l.qty * l.unit_price - l.discount), 2) AS revenue
FROM goeteborg_orders o
JOIN order_lines l ON o.order_id = l.order_id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND period IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period

        p.product_id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.brand,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN o.order_id END) * 1.0
            / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id END) AS return_rate,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN o.order_id END) AS returned_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id END) AS total_non_cancelled_orders
    FROM order_lines l
    JOIN orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p ON l.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.order_ts >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'
      AND o.order_ts <  '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, p.category, p.brand
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id END) > 0
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    name,
    category,
    brand,
    returned_orders,
    total_non_cancelled_orders,
    ROUND(return_rate * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM product_return_rate
ORDER BY return_rate DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH goeteborg_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.status,
        o.order_ts,

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    l.product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN o.order_id END) * 1.0
      / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id END) AS return_rate,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN o.order_id END) AS returned_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id END) AS total_non_cancelled_orders
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON l.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= '2026-10-13T00:00:00Z'
    AND o.order_ts <  '2026-10-20T00:00:00Z'
  GROUP BY l.product_id, p.name, p.category
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id END) > 0
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  product_name,
  category,
  returned_orders,
  total_non_cancelled_orders,
  ROUND(return_rate, 2) AS return_rate
FROM base
ORDER BY return_rate DESC, returned_orders DESC
LIMIT 5

The web channel has an average order value of 6,584.79 SEK in October 2026, based on 2,523 non-cancelled orders with total revenue of 1.661342E7 SEK.
The web channel's average order value is higher than the store channel's by 44.85 SEK (6,584.79 vs 6,539.94).

evidence.sql:
SELECT
    o.channel,
    ROUND(SUM(l.qty * l.unit_price - l.discount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS average_order_value,
    ROUND(SUM(l.qty * l.unit_price - l.discount), 2) AS total_revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS non_cancelled_orders
FROM lakehouse_demo.order_lines l
JOIN lakehouse_demo.orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND o.order_ts >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'
  AND o.order_ts < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z'
GROUP BY o.channel
ORDER BY o.channel

claims.statement: Göteborg's revenue last week (w42, 12–18 Oct 2026) was 1,059,350.70 SEK.
Göteborg's revenue the week before (w41, 5–11 Oct 2026) was 884,866.90 SEK.
Revenue increased by 174,483.80 SEK week-over-week, a rise of approximately +19.7%.

evidence.sql:
WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_ts >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z' AND o.order_ts < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z' THEN 'last_week (w42: 12–18 Oct)'
      WHEN o.order_ts >= '2026-10-05T00:00:00Z' AND o.order_ts < '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z' THEN 'week_before (w41: 5–11 Oct)'
    END AS week_label,
    ROUND(SUM(l.qty * l.unit_price - l.discount), 2) AS revenue
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE s.city = 'Göteborg'
    AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_ts >= '2026-10-05T00:00:00Z'
    AND o.order_ts < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT week_label, revenue
FROM weekly
ORDER BY week_label

claims.statement: Shorts Trail (Kust, Bottoms) had the highest return rate last week at 15.09% (8 returned out of 53 non-cancelled orders).
Sleeping Bag -5 (Björk & Co, Equipment) ranked 2nd with a return rate of 11.54% (6 of 52 orders).
Headlamp (Polaris Gear, Accessories) ranked 3rd with a return rate of 10.61% (7 of 66 orders).
Softshell (Björk & Co, Outerwear) ranked 4th with a return rate of 9.72% (7 of 72 orders).
Dry Bag 10L (Polaris Gear, Equipment) ranked 5th with a return rate of 8.93% (5 of 56 orders).

evidence.sql:
WITH product_return_rate AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.brand,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN o.order_id END) * 1.0
            / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id END) AS return_rate,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN o.order_id END) AS returned_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id END) AS total_non_cancelled_orders
    FROM order_lines l
    JOIN orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p ON l.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.order_ts >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'
      AND o.order_ts <  '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, p.category, p.brand
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id END) > 0
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    name,
    category,
    brand,
    returned_orders,
    total_non_cancelled_orders,
    ROUND(return_rate * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM product_return_rate
ORDER BY return_rate DESC
LIMIT 5

      AND o.order_ts < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'
)

FROM goeteborg_orders o
JOIN order_lines l ON o.order_id = l.order_id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND period IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period

evidence.sql:
WITH last_week_lines AS (
    SELECT
        l.product_id,
        o.order_id,
        o.status
    FROM lakehouse_demo.order_lines l
    JOIN lakehouse_demo.orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_ts >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'
      AND o.order_ts <  '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
),
product_return_rate AS (
    SELECT
        lwl.product_id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.brand,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lwl.status = 'returned' THEN lwl.order_id END) * 1.0
            / COUNT(DISTINCT lwl.order_id) AS return_rate,
        COUNT(DISTINCT lwl.order_id) AS total_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lwl.status = 'returned' THEN lwl.order_id END) AS returned_orders
    FROM last_week_lines lwl
    JOIN lakehouse_demo.products p ON lwl.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY lwl.product_id, p.name, p.category, p.brand
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    name,
    category,
    brand,
    returned_orders,
    total_orders,
    return_rate
FROM product_return_rate
ORDER BY return_rate DESC, total_orders DESC
LIMIT 5

claims.statement: The web channel has an average order value of 6584.79 SEK based on 2523 non-cancelled orders in October 2026 (MTD).
The store channel has an average order value of 6539.94 SEK based on 2096 non-cancelled orders in October 2026 (MTD).
The difference in average order value between web and store is 44.85 SEK (6584.79 - 6539.94).

evidence.sql:
SELECT
  o.channel,
  ROUND(SUM(l.qty * l.unit_price - l.discount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS average_order_value,
  ROUND(SUM(l.qty * l.unit_price - l.discount), 2) AS total_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS non_cancelled_orders
FROM order_lines l
JOIN orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND o.order_ts >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'
  AND o.order_ts <  '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z'
GROUP BY o.channel
ORDER BY o.channel

claims.statement: Göteborg's revenue last week (week 42) was 1059350.7 SEK
Göteborg's revenue the week before (week 41) was 884866.9 SEK
Revenue increased by 174483.8 SEK week-on-week, from 884866.9 to 1059350.7

evidence.sql:
WITH goeteborg_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.status,
        o.order_ts,
        CASE
            WHEN o.order_ts >= '2026-10-05T00:00:00Z' AND o.order_ts < '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z' THEN 'week_before'
            WHEN o.order_ts >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z' AND o.order_ts < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z' THEN 'last_week'
        END AS period
    FROM orders o
    JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.city = 'Göteborg'
      AND o.order_ts >= '2026-10-05T00:00:00Z'
      AND o.order_ts < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'
)
SELECT
    period,
    ROUND(SUM(l.qty * l.unit_price - l.discount), 2) AS revenue
FROM goeteborg_orders o
JOIN order_lines l ON o.order_id = l.order_id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND period IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY period

    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.brand,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN o.order_id END) * 1.0
            / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id END) AS return_rate,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN o.order_id END) AS returned_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id END) AS total_non_cancelled_orders
    FROM order_lines l
    JOIN orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p ON l.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.order_ts >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'
      AND o.order_ts <  '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, p.category, p.brand
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id END) > 0
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    name,
    category,
    brand,
    returned_orders,
    total_non_cancelled_orders,
    ROUND(return_rate * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM product_return_rate
ORDER BY return_rate DESC
LIMIT 5

claims.statement: Göteborg's revenue for last week (12–18 Oct 2026) was 1059350.7 SEK
Göteborg's revenue for the week before (5–11 Oct 2026) was 884866.9 SEK
Revenue increased by 174483.8 SEK week-on-week, approximately +19.7%

evidence.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_ts >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z' AND o.order_ts < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z' THEN 'last_week'
      WHEN o.order_ts >= '2026-10-05T00:00:00Z' AND o.order_ts < '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z' THEN 'week_before'
    END AS period,
    ROUND(SUM(l.qty * l.unit_price - l.discount), 2) AS revenue
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND s.city = 'Göteborg'
    AND o.order_ts >= '2026-10-05T00:00:00Z'
    AND o.order_ts < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT period, revenue FROM base ORDER BY period DESC

WITH weekly AS (

    CASE
      WHEN o.order_ts >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z' AND o.order_ts < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z' THEN 'last_week (w42: 12–18 Oct)'
      WHEN o.order_ts >= '2026-10-05T00:00:00Z' AND o.order_ts < '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z' THEN 'week_before (w41: 5–11 Oct)'
    END AS week_label,
    ROUND(SUM(l.qty * l.unit_price - l.discount), 2) AS revenue
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE s.city = 'Göteborg'
    AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_ts >= '2026-10-05T00:00:00Z'
    AND o.order_ts < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT week_label, revenue
FROM weekly
ORDER BY week_label

claims.statement: Shorts Trail (Kust, Bottoms) had the highest return rate last week at 15.09% (8 returned out of 53 non-cancelled orders).
Sleeping Bag -5 (Björk & Co, Equipment) ranked 2nd with a return rate of 11.54% (6 of 52 orders).
Headlamp (Polaris Gear, Accessories) ranked 3rd with a return rate of 10.61% (7 of 66 orders).
Softshell (Björk & Co, Outerwear) ranked 4th with a return rate of 9.72% (7 of 72 orders).
Dry Bag 10L (Polaris Gear, Equipment) ranked 5th with a return rate of 8.93% (5 of 56 orders).

evidence.sql:
WITH product_return_rate AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.brand,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN o.order_id END) * 1.0
            / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id END) AS return_rate,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN o.order_id END) AS returned_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id END) AS total_non_cancelled_orders
    FROM order_lines l
    JOIN orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p ON l.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.order_ts >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'
      AND o.order_ts <  '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, p.category, p.brand
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id END) > 0
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    name,
    category,
    brand,
    returned_orders,
    total_non_cancelled_orders,
    ROUND(return_rate * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM product_return_rate
ORDER BY return_rate DESC
LIMIT 5

evidence.sql:
WITH last_week_lines AS (
    SELECT
        l.product_id,
        o.order_id,
        o.status
    FROM lakehouse_demo.order_lines l
    JOIN lakehouse_demo.orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_ts >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'
      AND o.order_ts <  '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
),
product_return_rate AS (
    SELECT
        lwl.product_id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.brand,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lwl.status = 'returned' THEN lwl.order_id END) * 1.0
            / COUNT(DISTINCT lwl.order_id) AS return_rate,
        COUNT(DISTINCT lwl.order_id) AS total_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lwl.status = 'returned' THEN lwl.order_id END) AS returned_orders
    FROM last_week_lines lwl
    JOIN lakehouse_demo.products p ON lwl.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY lwl.product_id, p.name, p.category, p.brand
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    name,
    category,
    brand,
    returned_orders,
    total_orders,
    return_rate
FROM product_return_rate
ORDER BY return_rate DESC, total_orders DESC
LIMIT 5
